message: We all have that friend who starts to panic at the first sign of a storm, right? 😅 While we might not need to go that far, we find a little peace of mind in keeping a go-bag ready by the door. It’s our small way of being prepared for whatever life throws our way. Simple snacks and water can make a big difference, and they’re ready for those unexpected adventures! What’s your go-to tip for staying ready at home?
